verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents usage-based, pay-as-you-go pricing. You pay only for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you use, and Sprite disk is billed by the bytes written. This strongly implies cost is not tied to team seats. However, the evidence never explicitly says whether there are per-seat charges or minimum seat counts for org members. missing for 10: explicit statement on per-seat or per-member charges, documentation of any minimum seat or plan commitments as a team grows, independent corroboration of how team size affects billing.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know whether pricing is per-seat with minimum seat counts that increase cost as my team grows

citations.quote: Fly.io uses pay-as-you-go pricing - you only pay for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use.
you're only billed for the bytes you actually put there
